input.free_text_description: This system is a messaging platform that serves Admin, Candidate roles. The platform provides capabilities for agent manager. Secondary concerns include job/recommendation functionality.

user_stories.story: As an Admin, I want to manage system configuration and monitor operations, so that I can ensure the platform runs smoothly.
As a Admin, I want to interact with agent functionality, so that I can accomplish my agent-related tasks.
As a Admin, I want to access the system through a well-defined interface, so that I can perform my tasks efficiently.
As a Candidate, I want to view a summary of my recent activity, so that I can track my progress.
As a Admin, I want to update my preferences and settings, so that the system adapts to my needs.
